text:
alan: Quick heads-up: found several dead links in the Optimize toolkit examples pointing at old quant profile docs. Opening a small PR to fix links, add a brief bench snippet, and a migration note for streaming examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899
nina: Thanks! which quant presets were affected?
alan: Two old presets: `q8_old` and `q6_deprecated`. Replaced uses with `q8` and `q4` and added a short rationale block explaining the removal.
harish: I ran `mkdocs build` locally and got a table-wrap lint warning for the new rationale table.
alan: Fixed the table spacing and column widths in the latest commit. Also normalized line endings.
nina: Can we include a tiny perf snippet showing delta so readers understand impact? just 3 lines is fine.
alan: Added this Python micro-benchmark to the examples directory:```python
# quick perf: compare q8 vs q4
start = time.time()
client.generate(prompt, quant_profile='q8')
print('q8', time.time()-start)
```
Included sample outputs beneath it.
harish: Smoke test report: streaming example failed in staging because SDK v0.7 doesn't expose `streaming.enable()` import. stack trace points to examples/streaming.md line 12.
alan: Good catch. I wrapped streaming examples with a short compatibility guard and left a clear comment "requires SDK >= 0.8 for streaming API". Code snippet:```python
try:
    from redwood.streaming import enable
except ImportError:
    # fallback: streaming not available in older SDKs
    enable = None
```
nina: Can we also add a tiny migration note in /optimize/migration.md describing the streaming API change so teams know what to change?
alan: Done; created a subsection "Streaming API (v0.8+)" with before/after snippets and a short checklist.
ci-bot: CI: deploy-preview 4899 failed on check "docs-build" 1: streaming import error in examples/streaming.md:12 
harish: I pushed a commit that updates expected output for tokenizer differences too (small whitespace shift).
alan: Pushed the compatibility guard and the updated expected outputs. Triggered CI rerun.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-4899--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/benchmarks.html (staging)
ci-bot: CI: deploy-preview 4899 now: all checks passed 
nina: Assigning reviewers: @nina (content), @harish (QA), @alan (author). please leave a short :+1: or :x: with reason.
harish: LGTM once we remove that stray trailing space in the bench snippet. left a tiny inline comment.
alan: Removed trailing space and rebased. Plan to merge after 12h if no objections.
nina: Please backport the link fixes only to the 0.7 branch (no streaming guard backport).
alan: Opened backport PR #4900 with just link corrections; CI green there.
ci-bot: Backport PR 4900 pipeline: ✅ 
docs-bot: Note: I added a short redirect from the old quant-profiles URL to the new page to reduce 404s.
alan: Thanks all. This should clear up the link rot and make the bench/streaming examples clearer for teams migrating to v0.8+. Will follow up if any regression crops up.
